movie.title: The Ballad of Narayama
movie.tagline: With my mother on my back, now is the time to say goodbye to this world.
movie.overview: In a remote village where food is scarce, elders who reach the age of 70 are carried by their children to the top of a nearby mountain to die in solitude. Orin, a vibrant 69-year-old grandmother, has accepted her fate — but struggles to prepare the rest of her family for the ritual.
